display_long_description:
Welcome to Throwtopia – Where Throwing is the Only Rule!

Throwtopia is a whimsical VR throwing game that drops you into a low-poly, sunny, and slightly chaotic neighborhood environment. But beware: this isn't just any random throwing game—it's a humorous and fast-paced challenge requiring gender-specific targeting!

Gameplay Mechanics:

Aim and throw with your VR controllers.

You must hit Male NPCs wandering the neighborhood only with Soccer Balls.

You must hit Female NPCs wandering the neighborhood only with Soft Pillows.

Throw the wrong object at the wrong target, or miss, and you'll face a FAIL!

Why You'll Love It:

🎯 Precise & Humorous Targeting: The matching mechanic adds a unique layer of humor and challenge to the game.

✨ Low Poly Aesthetics: Visually pleasing with vibrant colors and a clean low-poly art style.

⏱️ Fast-Paced Action: Test your reflexes and accuracy to achieve the highest score.

📈 Replayability: Continuously hone your throwing skills to climb the leaderboards.

Are you ready to take control of the chaos and become Throwtopia's Ultimate Thrower?
